nodes.label: Loader rd<T> Integer-Overflow Bounds Fix
nodes.rationale: Root cause: the bounds check off + sizeof(T) <= d.size() wraps when off is near SIZE_MAX, letting a wild memcpy pass. Fixed to the no-wrap form off <= d.size() && sizeof(T) <= d.size() - off, neutralizing the reachable ELF OOB reads at every call site.

nodes.label: Live-View 0xCC Breakpoint Masking (readMemoryMasked)
nodes.rationale: The live view never masked the debugger's own 0xCC software breakpoints (showed int3 / desynced); readMemoryMasked is now used by all live decode/string/selection/signature paths, and the live decoder follows the debuggee's bitness (x86 for WOW64).

nodes.label: Deferred: CFG Mid-Instruction Branch-Target Leaders
nodes.rationale: Branch-target leaders landing mid-instruction are still dropped. A proper fix is overlapping-instruction re-decode at the unaligned target — a feature with real regression risk to normal-code CFGs, consciously deferred as a known limit (affects obfuscated code).
